dedupe_keys.name: co udlabs ta ikt 01 ltf monitoring water pressure surge effect in rehabilitated waste water pressure pipes

description: Verhulst, Danny at VLARIO publishes pressure-surge test measurements for rehabilitated wastewater pressure pipes through Co-UDlabs. An approximately 8-metre section was rehabilitated with a high-density-polyethylene close-fit liner in the IKT wastewater circuit. The system underwent a range of surge loads, and experimental results were compared with a simulation program. Coverage is the IKT large test facility in Germany; campaign dates and time steps are unspecified. Zenodo provides a measuring-data ZIP archive with free access under CC BY 4.0. These observations support the source-defined drainage measurement, physical-model or simulation activity. Related Co-UDlabs experiments describe other assets and test conditions; they are not assumed to be independent or interchangeable measurements. A limitation is the native description does not name the simulation program, enumerate loads or give sensor accuracy and does not establish performance for other liner systems. Only native metadata and file descriptors were read; no data values, archive, code or report body was obtained.
